title.narrative: Increased capacity of the constituents to implement sectoral international labour standards, codes of practice, guidelines and tools

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Preparation of new sectoral codes of practice, guidelines and other tools and facilitation of sectoral meetings of experts and technical meetings endorsed by the ILO Governing Body. (2) Delivery of sector-specific capacity development programmes, including in collaboration with the Turin Centre. (3) Promotion of sectoral policy coherence in coordination with other UN entities and multilateral organizations, including the revision of the joint ILO/UNESCO Recommendation concerning the Status of Teachers. (4) Dissemination of sectoral knowledge and further developing a web based sectoral data interface.
